title: Rule7 valid field non-matches fail instead of byte-preserving Rule255 fallback
description: Correctness review: Python and Rust Rule7 reject valid MQTT-SN IPv6/UDP packets with nonzero Traffic Class or Flow Label as fatal errors, while spec classifies these as matching requirements and requires fallback to another rule/Rule255. Valid non-matches must use byte-preserving Rule255; malformed lengths/checksums still fail. Add shared vectors for both fields.
